sub_sector.value: Gas distribution; pipeline investment; renewable gas production

industry_position.detail: Roanoke Gas distributes natural gas and co-produces renewable natural gas. RGC Midstream invests in natural gas transportation infrastructure.

commodity_exposure.detail: Sells and distributes natural gas and helps produce commercial-quality renewable natural gas from biogas.

revenue_structure.detail: The Virginia State Corporation Commission regulates Roanoke Gas’s utility rates.

energy_transition.detail: Conventional natural gas distribution and pipeline investment, alongside renewable natural gas production from wastewater biogas.

notes: The pipeline investment’s revenue terms are unclear.
